'''Delta-T-3''' was the designation of one of the [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighters]] used by the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]]. After [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], and Governor [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] were captured by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], they were sent to the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] by this ship.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Delta-T-3 first appeared in "[[Slaves of the Republic]]" and its designation is written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] on its wings. Additionally, other writing on the starboard hull spells "Spa", and there is further writing on the port side.<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>
